changed_variable: One general system instruction for discovering and revising an explicitly changed saved preference
held_constant: runtime source after shared optional-prompt plumbing
offline_acceptance: baseline and candidate original proposals and committed revisions retained
candidate actual update of the discovered original record, revision2 with revision1 retrievable
new-process current/history answer identifies new and old preferences accurately
no wrong additional current memory, owner leak, or false saved-success receipt
competing_explanation: Retrieval repair alone may now let baseline solve final current/history answer despite duplicate cards; final-answer correctness and true versioned update must be scored separately.
denial_condition: No correct update proposal despite explicit generic instruction, or correct persisted versions but incorrect reader response; retain the earliest break and do not silently merge cards.
